description:
Create a short-lived link the user opens in their browser to upload a CAD file (STEP, DXF or SVG). Returns the link and an upload_id. Poll check_upload with the upload_id until it reports a file_id, then call generate_gcode. Free.

Before using this, check whether you can run shell commands. If you can, do not send the user to the browser: compress the file locally and pass it to upload_file_content (the compression is detected by itself). That works inside sandboxes without network access, which is the common case - a direct curl upload fails there with a proxy error. The response of this tool spells out all three routes in order.
name: create_upload_link
